title: Nice fan and ok heater
text:
Nice fan and ok heater. The fan puts out very well. It has a strong wind to it. It's not a blower type of fan, but it blows pretty hard for this size of fan. The heater is just ok. It doesn't put out much heat. I have a little heater that I turn on in my bathroom and the room warms quickly. This one didn't have the room warm by the time I finished taking a shower. It will warm a small room or a small camper, but it takes time.

It is quiet and easy to work. Someone said something about buttons being difficult the fan/heater that I am leaving feedback on has a dial controller and it's easy to use. Turn to the left-low heat, another click to the left-high heat. Turn to the right, low fan, another click is high fan.

I love the safety feature of it turning off if it is moved or knocked over.

I haven't had it long to leave feedback on durability, but as of now, it's a nice little heater/fan.
